description: The robot's server-to-client topics in the Message oneof of platform_shared/message.proto, by tag, with their kind. A state topic holds one current value: a subscribe to it is answered with that value (the snapshot), then with the subscribe echoed as its ack, and every change follows. A stream topic is a sequence of frames: a subscribe to it is answered with the ack alone, and its frames follow while the client subscribes. A subscribe to a tag that is no topic is acked as a stream. A tag not listed is no topic. The firmware's table (firmware/include/communication/topics.h, test firmware/test/test_topic_snapshot) and the app's (app/src/lib/transport/topics.ts, test app/tests/unit/topics.spec.ts) are both checked against this file.
